rows.q4_rule: Reported fiscal year value minus same-fiscal-year nine-month cumulative value.
rows.ttm_rule: Sum exactly four consecutive, non-overlapping, basis-compatible quarter values with Decimal and no intermediate rounding.

unsupported_row_families.eps_and_per_share: Not among the 25 frozen rows. Per-share denominators and anti-dilution treatment make simple addition invalid.
unsupported_row_families.weighted_average_shares: Not among the 25 frozen rows. These are time-weighted quantities and need weighted-period reconstruction.
unsupported_row_families.ratios_and_margins: Not among the 25 frozen rows. Ratios are non-additive and require numerator and denominator policies.

source_conventions.apple_fx: Keep missing where Apple does not separately report the FX line. Do not insert zero or a balancing plug.
source_conventions.canonical_amounts: Apply inline XBRL scale and sign once to the original lexical Decimal. Preserve the raw lexical value and decimals attribute.
source_conventions.periods: Derive actual start and end from DEI and unsegmented XBRL contexts. Keep inclusive calendar-day counts.
source_conventions.point_in_time: Only source filings accepted at or before each case cutoff may supply an operand.
source_conventions.revision_basis: Keep filing and comparative candidates with their exact accession, accepted time, context, table and row. Do not mix incompatible restatements or bases.
